text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hey, Grandma! Tell me more about racing magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! You've really taken to that spell, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yeah! 'Cause it's a super strong spell even for you, right?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: If I run in races, will I be able to find it? Will I be able to use it?

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: Oh, but of course you will! You're the granddaughter of a great witch, after all!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: But it won't be easy to find, you know. It's a grand spell…

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: In fact, it even has the power to change people's lives.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Wow… Well, if you say it's a grand spell, then it must be really powerful.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I really hope I can find that racing spell soon…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: But if I run, people are just gonna tell me what to do again…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: All I wanna do is find racing magic.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: …I hate this.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …Hm?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Zzz… Zzz…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmph…

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant… I didn't win the Derby… but I'll win the Kikuka Sho for sure!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Onlookers
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: You were so wonderful in the Derby! I'll be cheering for you to win the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Derby Champion
text_block_list.text: Thanks for your support! I'm just glad I can be a source of courage for you all!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah! You're sooo cool!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: That's a double crown champion for you. Unlike me, she took the lead in the Classic Triple Crown…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Oh, Rob Roy! Um…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Y-you do your best too!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Haha… I will… Thank you…

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: …I ran off.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I came to this academy because I wanted to be a hero, and I'm racing because I want to change.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: But I'm still nothing. I haven't changed at all…

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: …Wait a second. That hat…

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Swee—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Shhh…

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I think she fell asleep. Don't wake her up.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hey… Grandma… Zzz…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: See? Look how much quieter she is like this. And she sounds cuter as well.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hehe… You're right.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I heard that her grandmother lives somewhere very verdant. Apparently, it's overflowing with flowers, just like this flower bed.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That's why I brought her here initially. I thought it'd be a nice place for her to rest when she needed it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But I can't let her skip training to come here. I intend to give her a piece of my mind when she wakes up.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: …Wow, Air Groove. You're really watching over her.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I am. I have high hopes for her. But I'm concerned at the same time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I believe she has the capacity to guide others. And I hope she takes care not to lose it.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: The capacity to guide others…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Don't tell her I said that. I don't want her getting cocky.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Mm… Mmm… Uhhh…

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text: You're amazing, Sweep! I can't believe you're getting times like these so soon after starting at the academy!

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text: I'm going to recommend you for tryouts! Make sure you listen to what the trainers say!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text: You need to hold back more at the start, Sweep! You'll be able to make better use of your strengths that way!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text: You can't just do whatever you want, Sweep Tosho. Your abilities will end up going to waste.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hey! Quit trying to control every little thing I do! I'm—

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B
text_block_list.text: This is all for your sake.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho! You need to be more…

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer C
text_block_list.text: That's not right, Sweep. You need to…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (Ugh… Here we go again…)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Zzz… Zzz… Hey… Grand…ma…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I don't… wanna…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ever since the incident at her debut, Sweep Tosho gets upset whenever the topic of racing is brought up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She struggles to concentrate before races, and I feel like her number of late starts has increased too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I need to get to the bottom of it all, but she only gets frustrated when I try talking to her about it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rattle…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Familiar! Take me to Grandma's house.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hurry! Hurry up and take me there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I manage to contact her grandmother, get her address, and secure a means of transportation.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: Hello! Welcome back, my adorable little Sweepy! It's been months since you've last graced this great witch's manor with your presence!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Guess what, Grandma! I was reading a book and I saw Undine's rainbow spell in there!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Can I try it out at the river?! I wanna show you my magic!
choice_data_list: You want to go to a river?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We've got two more months until the Hanshin J.F., which she herself suggested.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The river's freezing at this time of year. If she fell in and got sick, she might have to withdraw from the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I doubt the river is especially safe or looked after either. And her shoes aren't suited for walking near rivers. If she slipped in somewhere where the current was strong…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What is it, Familiar?
choice_data_list: The river's dangerous, and it's very cold at this time of year…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: So now you're gonna start talking about what's good for me too?

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, Sweepy. I'm sure that's not what your trainer means to say.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: But those shoes won't do for the river. If you're going to cast a spirit spell, you've got to wear clothes that are compatible with the area!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: …Ah.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: There, it looks like you've remembered. So, if you're going to practice magic by the river…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I need to be polite to the spirits and wear shoes that won't slip!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: That's right. And let's take a nice, warm scarf as well, in case you get cold! A scarf would be very compatible with the cold!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho changes her shoes and then begins chanting spells by the river.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her grandmother watches over her quietly, holding a towel and scarf in her hands.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: I'm terribly sorry for butting in earlier.
choice_data_list: Not at all. I should be thanking you for your help.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: I expect you've already realized this, but…

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: Sweepy is a very special child. She's positively overflowing with potential.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: That's why so many people have high hopes for her future, and why they've worried over her since she was little.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Grandma! Familiar! I'm gonna cast my spell somewhere else!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'll stay where you can see me, though! Make sure you keep watching so you don't miss the magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: Okay, Sweepy! We're watching!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: Having people worry for you is a wonderful thing. It means they really care about you.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: But have you ever felt that people are worrying about you so much because they don't have faith in you?

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: Adults have more wisdom and experience than children, so they often know the right path.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: But that isn't to say that children don't know the right path themselves.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: They have their own compass, and it works even without any guidance from adults. They're not babies, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: I don't want to guide her. I want to support her. This is her adventure.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Grandma! I'm starting to get chilly! Let's go and have some tea before I catch a cold!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's a wonderful idea! Let's go back to the house!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: Would you mind if we talked about this a little more, Trainer? I'll brew you some of my special herbal tea.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The three of us head back to Sweep Tosho's grandmother's house and enjoy some tea.
